profile_text: Growth-equity analyst at Northgate Capital in London. Weekends she hikes the Peak District and keeps a log of every ridge walk. Met at career fair at ExCeL; offered to refer me to their graduate scheme.
Backend engineer at Halcyon Data in Manchester. Freedives in Bali whenever he can get leave. Met at career fair at ExCeL; said contributing to open source got him the job.

Head of partnerships at Kestrel Pay, based in Singapore but in London for the week. Open-water swimmer; did a Channel relay last year. Met at fintech meetup in Shoreditch; wanted a follow-up on an integration conversation.
Product manager at Ledgerly in London. Climbs at the Arch in Bermondsey most Tuesdays. Met at fintech meetup in Shoreditch; hiring a junior PM intern for summer.
Growth lead at Beamlight Studio in Camden. Boulders at the Castle and runs a beginner Tuesday session. Met at rooftop mixer in Camden; told me to try the beginner bouldering session.

Roaster at Solvent Coffee in Mexico City. Keeps tasting notes like a diary and still plays five-a-side. Met at specialty coffee pop-up after a conference; ethiopian lot only lasts until the end of the month.
Paediatric dentist at Rowan Dental Care in Kuala Lumpur. Does the Penang open-water crossing every year. Met at alumni drinks at a hotel bar; said mention the alumni network if I ever book in.

Recently promoted partner in growth equity at Northgate Capital in Toronto. Competitive rower; trains at five in the morning. Met at startup pitch night in King's Cross; asked for the deck after a warm intro.
Barber at Hollis & Sons in Melbourne, in town for a pop-up. Walk-ins only; collects vintage clippers. Met at community barber takeover at a London pop-up; said ask for Dex himself, no appointments.
Typographic designer running Studio Neunzehn in Zürich. Binds books by hand and teaches the odd workshop. Met at design meetup at a print studio; studio is moving to Basel in spring because of rent.

Structural fabricator running Brandt Werk in Leipzig, staircases and mezzanines. Restores old BMWs; has been doing it since he was sixteen. Met at open workshop weekend; told me to send drawings for a mezzanine quote.

Physiotherapist who moved from Cork about eighteen months ago. Training for the Rotterdam Marathon; used to play camogie. Met at running-club social at a pub; said stop doing all my runs at the same pace.

Investigative reporter on the East Africa desk at Correspondent in Nairobi. Long-distance cyclist; rode Nairobi to Mombasa over a few days. Met at panel afterparty at a members' bar; signal only for anything sensitive.
Fourth-generation vigneron running Domaine Lassalle near Sauveterre. Still plays rugby in the front row. Met at wine fair afterparty; invited a harvest visit and offered a sample case in November.

Director of community programmes at Riverstone Trust in Portland, watershed restoration. Serious birder; was up at four for the estuary the morning we met. Met at volunteer open day; volunteer intake line is the best number.
Risograph and letterpress printer at Two Ply Press in Lagos. Collects old type drawers. Met at print-fair drinks; quote for exhibition posters; riso only, no digital.
Writer working on a poetry zine, visiting from Rome. Writes on night trains. Met at poetry zine launch in a basement bar; wants a collab on the winter issue.
Creative director at Atelier Seoyeon. Films city neon on a Super 8. Met at design-week booth drinks; looking for someone to take on motion work.
Actuary at Verity Mutual, lives in Haywards Heath. Smokes brisket on an offset; talks about bark like it is a science. Met at Saturday five-a-side then the pub.
Freelance product designer based in London. Two kids; the older one is called Danish. Met at UX talk drinks; looking for help with Webflow.

PhD student at Delft in computational biology, protein folding; goes by Sasha. Chess at a Kreuzberg club on Thursdays. Met at academic mixer after a guest lecture; said play a hundred games online before turning up.
Sound engineer for film, expanding into field recording. Records markets and trains; tells people to listen before buying mics. Met at film-industry mixer; in London for a Korean production.

Founder of Kaizen Freight, a twelve-person logistics software company; moved from Tokyo in 2019. Wheel-throwing pottery on weekends. Met at Startup Weekend at an old brewery; hiring advice: hire for who you are, not who you want to be.
Neighbour from house number 14 who keeps bees. Sells honey at the Saturday market. Met at Saturday market stall next to a community hall; told me to bring a jar home.
Applied cryptographer at Voidline Labs, SF / Berlin / Tokyo. Bouldering and terrible puns about hashes. Met at security meetup in a pub back room; happy to sanity-check a protocol write-up.
Independent curator in Rotterdam, contemporary sculpture. Two thousand jazz records; no more, her flatmate has banned it. Met at gallery opening; guest-curating a Brancusi-related show.
Landscape architect who just joined Veldt Studio in Cape Town. Rock climbing at Rocklands. Met at climate mixer; talked about drought-tolerant planting for a campus job.
Infrastructure engineer, PGP on her card, currently between teams. Trail running in Marin. Met at infra-meetup in a railway arch; said she might be hiring an intern once she lands.
Talent buyer at The Pilot Room in Chicago. DJs unfinished house edits at 2am. Met at music-industry night at a basement club; looking for a London support act in autumn.
Resident DJ and programmer at Basement 9 in Tokyo. Collects broken drum machines. Met at club-industry mixer; in London scouting a sister night.
Head baker at Sowden & Wick, a stone-milled bakery in Bristol. Keeps a sourdough like a pet. Met at food-community supper club; come Wednesday morning before the bake for starter.

Senior partner for audit at Halstead & Parr in Sydney. Restores antique clocks; about forty of them. Met at alumni drinks after a CA talk; offered to make a call for an FY audit intro; mobile not the direct line.
Ceramicist running his own wheel and kiln studio in Oaxaca. Fires experimental glazes at dawn. Met at craft fair drinks; studio visits by appointment.
Counsel at St Clair Chambers, Gray's Inn. Early-morning Thames rowing. Met at Inns of Court alumni drinks; said pupillage talks are less scary than they look.
Florist running Bloom & Bramble in Wellington, workshops as well as weddings. Forages on the south coast at low tide. Met at wedding-industry mixer; offered a weekend workshop slot.
Structural engineer, MSc, based in Trondheim. Winter cycling on studded tyres. Met at engineering society social; talked about a drawing revision labelled O4-REV.C.
Itamae running a six-seat omakase counter in Tokyo. Sharpens knives at 6am listening to city pop. Met at hospitality takeover dinner; reservations only; he remembered my allergy note.
Site foreman with CSCS Gold at Przybylski Groundworks. Sunday league football, left back. Met at construction-network breakfast then a caff; said the site office number never picks up, use mobile.
Documentary photographer shooting 35mm, based in Stockholm. Keeps a binder of contact sheets labelled ISO 400. Met at photo-book fair afterparty; looking for a fixer in Lagos next spring.
Sound engineer / FOH at Low End Room in London. Collects cheap dynamic mics and names them. Met at gig then the bar next door; said he can put me on the casuals list.
Notary and estates counsel in Copenhagen. Sails a folkboat in the Øresund. Met at legal-tech mixer; warned that English wills and Danish estates do not mix casually.
Product designer at Beamlight Studio in London. Trail running and a very battered paper notebook. Met at product meetup at a coworking attic; offered a portfolio review if I send work by Friday.
Principal at Northgate Capital in London. Chess on the train; blitz only. Met at startup pitch night in King's Cross; made the warm intro to Camille.
Engineer at Kestrel Pay, London office. Bouldering and sour beers after. Met at hackathon at Level39; teamed on a payments demo overnight.
Operations lead at Kaizen Freight in London. Weekend cycling out to Box Hill. Met at hackathon at Level39; looking for a student who can wrangle messy shipment CSVs.
Research engineer at Voidline Labs, London. Open-water swimming in the Serpentine. Met at hackathon at Level39; said their intern season opens in March.
Promoter working with The Pilot Room when they do London nights. Vinyl only, no USBs. Met at community radio fundraiser; needs a door person who can actually count.
Indie developer from Bergen shipping a tiny puzzle game. Hikes fjord trails with a sketchbook. Met at game-dev meetup; looking for a sound person, not a publisher.
Founder of a small air-quality hardware lab in London. Runs along the Lea at dawn. Met at climate mixer; looking for a cofounder who can do firmware, not another pitch deck.
Angel investor from Edinburgh, writes small cheques into student startups. Hillwalking in the Cairngorms. Met at startup pitch night in King's Cross; told me to email a twelve-line memo, not a deck.
Photographer from Beirut documenting port reconstruction. Prints in a shared darkroom. Met at photo-book fair afterparty; wants a London printer who will not flatten the blacks.
Studio manager at Calder Studio in London. Sea swimming year round, even in January. Met at materials fair at the Truman Brewery; introduced me to Margot.

Interior architect running Calder Studio in London, mostly residential plus a bit of hospitality. Sea swimming in the Serpentine all year; says the trick is not thinking about it. Met at materials fair at the Truman Brewery; worth a call about the flat; intro from Owen.
Trainee solicitor at Hale Legal in London. Chess in Lincoln's Inn gardens when it is dry. Met at Inns of Court alumni drinks; offered to look over a tenancy contract.
Data scientist at Halcyon Data in Manchester. Bouldering and terrible puns about features. Met at career fair at ExCeL; said their intern review is kinder than it sounds.
Graduate analyst at Verity Mutual in London. Five-a-side and a spreadsheet for expected goals. Met at career fair at ExCeL; walked me through their graduate assessment day.
Producer at Beamlight Studio. Takes brutalist photos on a half-frame camera. Met at rooftop mixer in Camden; needs a student who can edit vertical video without making it shout.
Compliance lead at Ledgerly in London. Marathon training along the canal. Met at fintech meetup in Shoreditch; said most intern CVs ignore the regulated-bit on purpose.
Editor at a small investigative desk in Warsaw, in London for a fellowship. Long runs before breakfast. Met at journalism mixer after a panel; wants stringers who can read company filings.
Print assistant helping Two Ply Press on a London residency. Riso test prints of bus tickets. Met at print-fair drinks; said they need someone for a Saturday edition.
Operator who helps Portuguese founders land in London. Sailing on the Tagus when she is home. Met at startup pitch night in King's Cross; looking for a student who can do messy market maps.
Climbing instructor at a London wall, also writes route-setting notes. Trad climbing in Wales when the rain allows. Met at climbing-gym social; beginner course starts Thursday, mention the social.
Motion designer running a one-person studio in London. Ceramics on Wednesday nights. Met at design meetup at a print studio; might subcontract the Atelier Seoyeon motion job.
Urban ecologist collaborating with Veldt Studio, currently in London. Birding in wet woodlands. Met at climate mixer; wants student surveyors for a park count.
UK partnerships for Riverstone Trust, based in London. Canal kayaking. Met at volunteer open day; needs weekend volunteers who will actually turn up in rain.
Export manager for Domaine Lassalle, in London for buyers. Sunday league rugby with a club in Clapham. Met at wine fair afterparty; looking for a student who can do bilingual tasting notes.
Recruiter at Kestrel Pay covering intern and new-grad roles in London. Parkrun every Saturday, rain or no. Met at career fair at ExCeL; told me to send a CV with one project, not twelve.
Startup lawyer from Berlin who does English/German SHA reviews. Bouldering in a dreary hangar in Wedding. Met at legal-tech mixer; student rate if the cap table is not a war crime yet.
Type designer from Lyon visiting a London foundry. Letterpress and very slow lunches. Met at design meetup at a print studio; needs a student to help document a revival.
London producer for Correspondent's Africa desk. Football podcasts on the night bus. Met at panel afterparty at a members' bar; looking for a fixer who understands FOI.
Security engineer from Budapest, currently contracting in London. Chess puzzles on her phone in queues. Met at security meetup in a pub back room; will review a threat model if it fits on one page.

Paediatric nurse at Mercy General with nine years on the ward. Learning Japanese twenty minutes a day; Osaka in November. Met at community hall fundraiser; funny, tired, and would still look at a volunteering rota.
Flatmate of a physiotherapist; works nights in a warehouse. FIFA and very strong tea. Met at housewarming then the corner pub; said Siobhan is the one to message about the running group.
Freelance UX researcher based in London. Pottery throwing badly and happily. Met at UX talk drinks; needs participants for a study on student banking.
Apprentice at Brandt Werk, Otto's nephew. Motocross on Sundays. Met at open workshop weekend; speaks better English than he thinks; wants a London placement.

MSc student, graduated two years ago, now at Halcyon Data as a backend engineer while finishing a module. Freediving and Sunday badminton. Met at career-fair coffee queue on campus, then we realised we share lectures; met properly in the databases class afterwards.
BSc student in the CM3070 final-project class. Bouldering at a wall near campus. Met at CM3070 seminar; offered to be a user-test guinea pig for my PWA.
MSc student who actually understands the ML derivations. Chess in the common room between lectures. Met at machine learning lecture; shares notes if you bring coffee.
BSc student in the HCI seminar, wants to do product design after. Film photography on a broken SLR. Met at HCI seminar; sat next to me and annotated every slide.
MSc student who already works part-time as a data analyst. Five-a-side after labs. Met at databases lab; explained Postgres FTS like a human.

PhD student working on retrieval and embeddings, TA for the ML module. Trail running before seminars. Met at guest lecture on embeddings; office hours Thursday; she will roast a bad evaluation design.
BSc student building a habit-tracker for his final project. Climbing gym twice a week. Met at CM3070 seminar; wants to swap user tests.
MSc student pivoting from biology into data. Open-water swimming at the lido. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; CV workshop pair; she rewrote my bullet points.
BSc student who runs the quiet study group on the third floor. Speed chess with a clock that beeps too loud for the library. Met at library study group; saves a seat if you text before six.
MSc student from Milan, previously at a bank, now full-time study. Rowing on the Tideway at dawn. Met at machine learning lecture; explains backprop with espresso metaphors.
BSc student interested in accessibility research. Photography of signage that fails in the rain. Met at HCI seminar; sat on my left; wants a dissertation partner next year.
MSc student who used to be a DBA. Hillwalking whenever the labs end early. Met at databases lab; will look at a schema if it is actually normalised.
BSc student building a local-first notes app. Hackathons more than lectures, by his own admission. Met at CM3070 seminar; looking for a cofounder who can design, not another engineer.
PhD student in NLP, gave the guest slot when the speaker was late. Pottery on campus on Fridays. Met at guest lecture on embeddings; warned me not to eval generation with exact string match.
BSc student applying to graduate schemes in consulting. Parkrun and a very colour-coded Notion. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; swap mock interviews.
MSc student from Lisbon, systems and networks. Sailing club on the reservoir. Met at library study group; brings snacks; enforces the no-Slack-during-Pomodoro rule.
BSc student who sits in the front row and asks the awkward questions. Football in the park after class. Met at machine learning lecture; has last year's exam sketches, use at your own risk.
MSc student with a psychology undergrad, now HCI. Documentary photography of commute faces, anonymised. Met at HCI seminar; wants participants for a diary study.
BSc student who broke the shared database twice and then wrote the recovery doc. Cycling home along the canal. Met at databases lab; knows the lab passwords we are not supposed to know.
MSc conversion student, previously a nurse, now building a shift-app. Open-water swimming and very dry jokes about rotas. Met at CM3070 seminar; user research gold if your app touches healthcare.
BSc student who organises the computing society talks. Hackathons and instant noodles. Met at academic society talk; can put me on the speaker dinner list.
PhD student in IR; argued with the guest about HyDE. Trail running and arguing about eval metrics. Met at guest lecture on embeddings; lent me a paper on hypothetical document embeddings.
MSc student targeting fintech internships. Climbing and a spreadsheet of every application. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; shared a live doc of cover-letter scraps.
BSc student, French Erasmus, discrete maths and coffee. Rugby for a university side. Met at library study group; translates papers faster than DeepL and will tell you so.
MSc student who interned at a Tokyo lab on protein models. Pottery and very neat lecture notes. Met at machine learning lecture; knows Sasha from a summer school.
BSc student who prototypes in Figma during the lecture. DJ sets in student union basements. Met at HCI seminar; will critique a flow if you buy the chips.
MSc student who cares about indexes more than UI. Long-distance cycling to Brighton and back. Met at databases lab; explained EXPLAIN ANALYZE on a napkin.
BSc student making an offline-first field-notes app. Birding on campus with cheap binoculars. Met at CM3070 seminar; wants a climate-NGO testers list.
MSc student who presented her internship at Correspondent. Journalism society and late trains. Met at academic society talk; can intro a student stringer slot.
BSc student who already interned at Ledgerly last summer. Five-a-side and a fintech newsletter addiction. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; will mock the online assessment if I buy lunch.
MSc student in information security. Lockpicking club, allegedly academic. Met at library study group; will not help you hack anything; will help you write a threat model.
BSc student who ships tiny models on-device for fun. Hiking the South Downs when the code compiles. Met at machine learning lecture; has a spare Coral stick if I am nice.
MSc student researching recall UIs for personal knowledge. Keeps analog index cards, ironically. Met at HCI seminar; wants to user-test whatever I build for iMet.
BSc student who wants to be a DBA and will not be talked out of it. Photography of server-room aesthetics. Met at databases lab; knows who actually runs the lab VMs.
MSc student from Oslo building a language-tandem app. Cross-country skiing when she can find snow, otherwise canal running. Met at CM3070 seminar; needs bilingual testers.
BSc student in the climate tech society. Community garden and very earnest Slack messages. Met at academic society talk; looking for a hardware cofounder, not another slide deck.
PhD student, TA for databases, quietly fixes everyone's SQL. Chess and terrible coffee from the machine. Met at guest lecture on embeddings; lab help Friday mornings.
MSc student targeting product roles, previously a teacher. Bouldering because marking used to ruin her wrists. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; gave the best STAR-method roast I have heard.
BSc student who brings a kettle and becomes the group. Folk guitar quietly, after hours. Met at library study group; knows every extension-deadline rumour.
MSc student working part-time at Kestrel Pay as a research intern. Open-water swimming with Nia sometimes. Met at machine learning lecture; can explain what the intern manager actually wants.
BSc student from Porto, interaction design track. Sailing club and espresso opinions. Met at HCI seminar; sat behind me and lent a charger twice.
MSc student who interned on search at a newspaper. Long runs and even longer SQL. Met at databases lab; cares about ranking more than storage.
BSc student building a climbing-log PWA, slightly too on the nose. Climbing, obviously, and bad instant coffee. Met at CM3070 seminar; wants to compare onboarding flows.
MSc student who booked the journalism guest. Podcast editing in a cupboard. Met at academic society talk; needs a sound check volunteer next month.
BSc student aiming at quant internships and pretending not to be nervous. Chess.com blitz in every queue. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; has a tracker of every OA.
MSc student, previously a baker, now doing CS. Sourdough that puts Sowden & Wick to shame, she says. Met at library study group; brings leftover loaves on Sundays.
BSc student who reimplements papers in tiny notebooks. Cycling at night with a terrible light. Met at machine learning lecture; will pair on a loss function if you bring batteries.
MSc student from Riga researching trust in recall systems. Film cameras and very sharp critiques. Met at HCI seminar; wants to sit in on a think-aloud if I ever eval the UI.
BSc student who wants to work in journalism data desks. FOI requests as a hobby, which is a choice. Met at databases lab; Isabelle already intro'd him to a stringer chat.
MSc student building a volunteering-match app for river cleanups. Kayaking and climate marches. Met at CM3070 seminar; Hannah at Riverstone would like her, I should intro.
BSc student who runs the hackathon Slack and the snack budget. Football Manager and actual football, equally badly. Met at academic society talk; needs mentors for the spring hack.
PhD student in speech, TA who actually answers emails. Choir, unexpectedly. Met at guest lecture on embeddings; can intro the ASR reading group.
MSc student targeting backend internships, previously support. Bouldering because sitting in tickets destroyed his back. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; Jordan at Halcyon already has his CV.
BSc student who colour-codes everything and somehow it works. Trail running before the library opens. Met at library study group; will share Anki decks if you contribute two cards.

MSc student, previously a paediatric nurse like Pauline, now ML for health. Learning Japanese with her, twenty minutes, no excuses. Met at machine learning lecture; wants labelled ward-shift data, ethically.
BSc student obsessed with onboarding copy. Stand-up in tiny rooms. Met at HCI seminar; will rewrite a tooltip for fun.
MSc student who cares about FTS config the way others care about fonts. Hillwalking and arguing about stemming. Met at databases lab; Kate already trusts his PRs.

BSc student making a relationship-CRM, uncomfortably close to my project. Pottery and oversharing about eval. Met at CM3070 seminar; we agreed not to copy each other and then immediately swapped metric ideas.
MSc student who interned at a climate hardware lab. Running and repairing sensors. Met at academic society talk; Anika is looking for firmware; he is not, but he knows people.
BSc student targeting journalism internships and data desks. Documentary photography. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; Kwame asked if she can FOI; she already can.
MSc student from Brazil, distributed systems. Football and a guitar he cannot fit in the hall. Met at library study group; enforces the silent hour and then breaks it.
BSc student who wants to do a PhD and will not shut up about it. Rowing and annotated PDFs. Met at machine learning lecture; Mei already told her to wait a year.
MSc student with a civil-engineering undergrad, now UX for infrastructure. Climbing walls and arguing about affordances. Met at HCI seminar; Amara would like him; I should intro.
BSc student who wants product, not DBA, and is stuck in the lab anyway. Ceramics elective she takes more seriously than SQL. Met at databases lab; Leila already offered a motion-design shadow day.
MSc student building an angel-memo helper, which Callum Reid would hate. Hillwalking and tiny cheques in a spreadsheet. Met at CM3070 seminar; wants intro to Reid if I am not embarrassing.
BSc student who books music guests for the society. DJ practice with Kiko's broken-machine aesthetic. Met at academic society talk; Cass wanted a London support; she has names.
MSc student targeting logistics internships after a warehouse year. Cycling to campus from too far away. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; Luis at Kaizen already wants the CSV person.
BSc student from Bergen who already ships tiny games. Hiking and sketching lecture theatres. Met at library study group; Freya Nilsen is not her aunt, they checked, it was awkward.
MSc student who interned on growth at Beamlight. Bouldering with Elena's Tuesday beginners, ironically advanced. Met at machine learning lecture; can explain what a growth lead actually measures.
BSc student researching how people recall names they half-heard in bars. Journaling and terrible memory, which is on-theme. Met at HCI seminar; wants my recall logs if I ever anonymise them.
MSc student who wants to work in wine-export ops, of all things. Rugby and tasting notes. Met at databases lab; Felix Moreau needs bilingual notes; Andre is the person.
BSc student building a field-recording archive app. Sound walks; Hyejin would approve. Met at CM3070 seminar; needs storage advice, not another moodboard.
MSc student who used to play club rugby and now organises alumni panels. Rugby, obviously, and very long emails. Met at academic society talk; Vivienne already agreed to a chambers talk.

BSc student targeting audit internships because Gwendolyn made it sound less awful. Clock restoration YouTube and actual tiny gears. Met at career-skills workshop on campus; wants that mobile number, not reception.
MSc student who TAs the quiet hours even though he is not a TA. Chess and instant noodles, Harry's rival. Met at library study group; will save a seat if Harry does not.
